freezeRule: First Git commit adding this exact protocol; all real evaluation timestamps must be strictly later than its committer time. Later protocol/implementation edits invalidate this identity.

baseline.meaning: Already inspected development evidence, not a final holdout

singleChange: On a baseline discretionary z-score exit before maxHoldBars, sell only if the current-quote modeled full-fill sale proceeds after exit fee/slippage cover actual remaining open lot cost including paid entry fees. Unknown basis blocks only discretionary exit. 20-bar forced exit is unconditional.

minimumEligibility.meaning: A minimum collection threshold only, not statistical proof; never sufficient for promotion

availability.rule: All market data that already occurred before registration, including not-yet-downloaded past rows, are development/warmup. Genuine future observations must be received before the next decision/fill tick; late batch downloads cannot certify prospective evidence.

benchmark: Quantity 3 held from first eligible quote with identical capital, risk, fee/slippage and next-event fill semantics. Marked terminal equity for every arm, plus a separate hypothetical liquidation estimate.

analysisPlan.winDenominator: All fully closed trades, including losses and breakevens; open trades excluded and explicitly reported
analysisPlan.winUncertainty: Two-sided Wilson 95%, descriptive only; IID assumptions, time dependence and prior selection multiplicity disclosed
analysisPlan.effectUncertainty: No effect CI from a single small window; retain point estimates and explicit non-determination until independent time blocks and verified economics exist
economicMetrics: return differences versus baseline and matched benchmark
analysisPlan.failureInterpretation: Higher win rate alone does not establish benefit. Longer exposure, worse cost-adjusted return/drawdown, or unresolved economics can reject/leave hypothesis inconclusive. No threshold/grid tuning in this identity.

unresolvedEconomics: independent official-response authenticity and trading-calendar coverage

priorRejectedResearch.method: 10-month SMA versus cost-matched benchmark on already seen data
priorRejectedResearch.disposition: Not stable improvement; not rerun or counted as unseen evidence

attemptAccounting: One fixed hypothesis. Every input snapshot/rejection is retained with raw input and exact SHA-256 in exclusive immutable files. Replays of the same bytes reuse one attempt. Cumulative updated snapshots overlap: never sum their trade counts or treat them as independent trials. Existing accumulator, journal and frozen champion/challenger are untouched.
currentBatch: Synthetic behavior validation and registration only. No network fetch, heavy backtest, model/solver experiment, trading, deployment, root checkout switch or legacy data deletion.
